project_type: TanStack Start + React 19 SPA/SSR CRM with Supabase (Postgres + Deno Edge Functions) backend and a Cloudflare Worker; shared Gmail is bridged via a Google Apps Script Web App.
language: TypeScript (React front end; Deno for Supabase edge functions; Google Apps Script (.gs) for the Gmail side)
build_system: bun (bun.lock present). Node also available. Supabase CLI for `functions deploy` and `db push`.
test_framework: No unit test framework is wired up in this repo (no test runner in package scripts observed). Verification is by typecheck/build and code inspection.
build_command: bun run build (CANNOT run in sandbox: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY blocks `bun install`, npm registry 403). CI must run it.
test_command: No test suite. CI typecheck/build is the gate. In-sandbox: careful code inspection only.
verification_instructions: 1) Confirm the new edge function `gmail-tag-sync/index.ts` follows the CRON_SECRET auth + service-role client pattern of `process-reminders`. 2) Confirm dedup logic queries existing leads by BOTH real customer email and relay sender address, lowercased, before inserting. 3) Confirm inserts satisfy leads NOT NULL columns (client_name, mobile) and set source='email', assigned_to=owner profile id, created_by=owner id (or a fallback). 4) Confirm the new Apps Script action enumerates ALL threads with a '<Name> lead' label via GmailApp.search, paginated, not just inbox page 1. 5) Confirm the gmail-bridge `taggedThreads`/`threadsByLabel` action forwards to the Apps Script and returns bodies or is paired with per-thread body fetch. 6) Confirm the client auto-sync effect no longer silently drops unmatched owner tags and no longer creates duplicates against the server sync. 7) Confirm a setup SQL to schedule the cron exists, matching SCHEDULE_REMINDERS_CRON.sql / ADD_STALE_FOLLOWUP_CRON.sql style. CI runs bun run build / typecheck.
setup_instructions: Normally `bun install` then `bun run dev`. NOT POSSIBLE in sandbox (network INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, npm 403). Supabase deploy: `supabase functions deploy gmail-tag-sync`; run the new setup SQL in the Supabase SQL editor to schedule pg_cron. Update the Apps Script by pasting the revised setup/gmail-apps-script.gs and redeploying the Web App.
environment_constraints: NETWORK = INTEGRATIONS_ONLY. `bun install` fails (npm 403); cannot run dev server, real build, lint, typecheck, or tests in-sandbox. All verification is by code inspection and pattern-consistency. Deploying the edge function, running the cron SQL, and updating the Apps Script are OUT OF SANDBOX steps the repo owner/CI must perform. The Apps Script source lives in setup/gmail-apps-script.gs but the LIVE deployed script is external and must be manually updated by the owner.
contribution_requirements: Work on a NEW feature branch (do NOT commit to main). Do not push or open PRs (orchestrator handles that). Match existing edge-function conventions: CORS headers, CRON_SECRET auth (body.secret or x-cron-secret header), createClient with SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, json() helper, fail-soft 200 responses. Match cron setup SQL placeholder style (<PROJECT_REF>, <ANON_KEY>, <CRON_SECRET>). Preserve existing manual claim/markMine/assign behavior and existing dedup so no duplicate leads are created.
key_patterns: Edge functions use Deno.serve, a corsHeaders const, a json(payload,status) helper, and fail-soft by returning {ok:false,error} with 200. Cron functions (process-reminders, notify-stale-followups) authenticate via CRON_SECRET and use the service-role client to bypass RLS. gmail-bridge proxies GET (?action=inbox|thread) and POST (action=claim) to the Apps Script Web App using GMAIL_WEBHOOK_URL + GMAIL_TOKEN. Client lib src/lib/gmail.ts holds parseFrom, claimedOwner, normalizeOwnerTag, parseWeb3FormLead, isThrowawayAddress, htmlToText. inbox.tsx has matchOwnerToUser(ownerTag, team) and resolveLeadFields(email) => {fields, dedupKeys:[realEmail, senderAddr]}. leads table: client_name NOT NULL, mobile NOT NULL, email nullable, source default 'website' (use 'email'), stage default 'new_lead', assigned_to nullable FK, created_by nullable FK, lead_code auto. leads_insert RLS requires admin/sales/bd — service role bypasses RLS. Apps Script inbox action = GmailApp.getInboxThreads(start,max) returning {threadId,from,subject,date,unread,labels[],url}; doPost claim adds a label + markRead; caches pages 300s.
relevant_files: src/routes/_authenticated/inbox.tsx (auto-sync useEffect, matchOwnerToUser, resolveLeadFields, claim/markMine/assign mutations — the client crux)
src/lib/gmail.ts (parsing + owner-tag helpers to reuse; may extract shared logic for server reuse)
supabase/functions/gmail-bridge/index.ts (proxy to Apps Script; add a taggedThreads action)
supabase/functions/process-reminders/index.ts (canonical cron function pattern: CRON_SECRET auth + service-role client)
setup/gmail-apps-script.gs (Apps Script source; add a search-by-label action for full-mailbox coverage)
setup/SCHEDULE_REMINDERS_CRON.sql and setup/ADD_STALE_FOLLOWUP_CRON.sql (cron scheduling SQL templates to mirror)
directory_structure: src/routes/_authenticated/ = authed pages (inbox.tsx). src/lib/ = client helpers (gmail.ts, auth). supabase/functions/<name>/index.ts = Deno edge functions. supabase/migrations/ = tracked SQL migrations. setup/ = one-off SQL + Apps Script + setup docs (cron templates live here). Cloudflare Worker entry in src/server.ts.
